fusions.name: Feint Through the Ranks
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles into the enemy line, dealing 10 damage and turning up to 3 enemies within 3.5 tiles against each other for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Doubling Back
fusions.desc: Wheels back on an enemy at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with rank, and deals 20 damage, using up every affliction on it to add 1.5 times their remaining damage. It has 30% more critical chance against a target that has not yet bled.

fusions.name: Laid False Trail
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and raises your movement speed by 20% while it holds. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Moonlit Jinking
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
